title: Add durable provider-neutral Issue dispatch guard
body:
## Summary
- add a provider-neutral, machine-readable Issue dispatch outcome and candidate contract
- durably reserve incarnation-scoped handoff ownership before remote callbacks and fail closed across concurrency, restarts, tracking failures, and stale finalization
- migrate existing CloudRun and CloudManager ownership as suppressing evidence while preserving explicitly authorized new-attempt isolation
- document the pre-integration boundary and dashboard observability impact
- add production-store regression coverage for the six acceptance scenarios

## Testing
- `bash scripts/test.sh tests/test_issue_dispatch.py`
- `bash scripts/test.sh -m "not browser and not opencode_live"`

Closes #2077
